reports.title: MATSON, INC. ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS AND RAISES FULL YEAR OUTLOOK

lines: As a result, we expect Ocean Transportation operating income in the fourth quarter 2026 to be approximately 50 percent higher than the result achieved in the year ago period.
Taken together, we expect consolidated operating income in the fourth quarter 2026 to be approximately 50 percent higher than fourth quarter 2025.”
For full year 2026, the Company expects the contribution from SSAT to be lower than the $32.5 million achieved in full year 2025.

Based on the outlook trends noted above, the Company expects Ocean Transportation operating income in the fourth quarter 2026 to be approximately 50 percent higher than the $136.0 million achieved in the fourth quarter 2025.
For the fourth quarter 2026, the Company expects Logistics operating income to be modestly higher than the $7.7 million achieved in the fourth quarter 2025.

Consolidated Operating Income: For the fourth quarter 2026, the Company expects consolidated operating income to be approximately 50 percent higher than the $143.7 million achieved in the fourth quarter 2025.
